results.description:
Discover a world where you can collect, trade and play your Topps digital trading cards against the biggest football fans around the world and be able to print the Topps® cards you collect! Digital and physical strategic card games collide in Topps Total Football®.

NEW AGE OF COLLECTING. Collect digital trading cards of the biggest stars in world football competition, use them to compete in an incredible card game and then receive physical Topps cards using the card print on-demand feature! Rip digital packs for a chance to find redemption cards to receive physical Topps Hobby Box card products & more!

OFFICIALLY LICENSED. The premier destination for officially licensed player and club collectible Topps cards of the Premier League, UEFA Champions League®, UEFA Europa League®, UEFA Europa Conference League®, and Major League Soccer. 

TAKE ON THE WORLD. Every week, Topps Total Football players from around the world will compete in our global league system to prove who is the best digital card game player and destined for the very top of the Topps Total Football table!

FIND THE BEST DEALS. The in-app card trading system allows you to trade for the football cards you need to add to your collection and deck! Buy & Sell Cards in the bustling in-app trading card Marketplace.

CRAFT EXCLUSIVE FUSION CARDS. Take your collection to the next level with the all-new fusion feature to craft exclusive, powerful collectibles. Combine 10 cards to build "formations" and craft a Fusion card. Boost your odds of pulling a rare parallel version of the card - up to 6x the chance!

PERSONALISE YOUR GAME. With collectable cosmetics like Avatars, Banners, Footballs and Card Backs, you’ll be able to create your unique football club & card trader identity.
